comparators: saved raw26 ridge predictions; contextual only
lambda_rationale: Preserve the same lambda selected in every one of the 8 preceding raw36 ridge folds; this ablation does not select lambda. Prior development exposure retained.
numerical_advantage: Both all32 MAE and RMSE strictly below constant AND saved raw36 ridge; numerical description, not significance or safety evidence
only_method_change: For each fold, center and population-standardize columns using the 28 training states only. Columns with training std <=1e-12 are set to zero on both train and held rows. No clipping of nonconstant held values.
outer: 8 unchanged source-run folds, 28 train and4 held; same row order
solver: same ridge normal-equation solve as preceding release
